explanations: Python evaluates default argument values once, when the def statement runs, so os.urandom(16) produced a single salt at import time that every later call reused. All users therefore share one salt, which defeats the point of salting: equal passwords hash equally and one precomputed table cracks the whole database. Defaulting to None and generating the salt inside the function gives each call a fresh random salt, while an explicitly passed salt still works for verification and tests.
